## Historical audit: S0142, chunk 1 of 5

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/generic_rsi/C1/development/commons_109923183/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to JSONL lines in that file. Neither the reference photograph nor the rendered image is visible in the supplied observations.

| Question | Evidence and finding |
|---|---|
| Goal | The instructed goal was a separate-mesh reconstruction of a single indoor photograph, matching viewpoint, framing, occlusion, colors and materials; no additional views or reference-image projection were allowed (student `model_request`, line 1). The student’s interpretation of the subject as an antique chaise and foreground cane chair is inferred from its code, not independently verified. |
| Actual build | The student produced a nonempty program, which was submitted as execution step 1 (student `model_response`, line 3; `execute`, line 4). It constructs architecture, parquet, chaise frame and legs, a separate foreground chair, curtains, cushions, pillow and label. It also defines procedural upholstery stripes and bump, pillow bump, a camera, world and area lights. This is evidence of multiple modeled components and materials, not their visual accuracy. |
| Connections and pose | Rails, legs, back and arms are assembled under the chaise asset; cushions and panels are separately created after realization. Their coordinates and rotations express intended support and a leaning pillow, but no contact, intersection or pose test is shown (lines 3–4). |
| Camera and render | The program records estimated image landmarks, uncertain depth and rear legs, and an elevated camera assumption; it specifies lens 48 and two lights (lines 3–4). The step-1 `execution_result` reports `ok: true`, no error, a completed render and saved image; a subsequent `select` names step 1 (lines 5–6). This is execution-level success, not independent confirmation of framing, lighting, texture, connections or resemblance. |
| Exploration and teaching | The visible fresh student CLI session completed with zero tool calls (line 2); the visible trajectory contains one build and execution. No teacher input, detection, diagnosis, proposed update, receipt or adoption appears in this chunk. The general scene-building instructions in line 1 are task instructions, not evidence of a teacher intervention. |

**Outcome and uncertainty.** Step 1 formally executed and was selected, but overall task correctness and final outcome are **unknown** from this chunk. There is no visible image comparison or student render review, and the other four chunks must not be inferred. In particular, possible camera displacement, incorrect object placement or disconnected parts remain hypotheses, not observed defects.

**Lessons.** Transferably, a successful renderer status establishes that code ran, not that a reconstruction matches its source; visual and geometric checks remain distinct. Task-specific choices—chaise proportions, parquet, striped upholstery and camera pose—are recorded assumptions whose validity cannot be established here.
